messages.english: Strange energies course through your body.
messages.translation: 奇异的能量流经你的身体。

messages.english: This spell isn't strong enough to banish yourself.
messages.translation: 这个法术的力量不足以放逐你自己。

messages.english: You feel a momentary urge to oink.
messages.translation: 你短暂地产生了学猪叫的冲动。

messages.english: You feel yourself grow more vulnerable to poison.
messages.translation: 你感觉自己变得更容易受到毒素伤害。
你感到一阵不祥的预兆……
你的身体被痛苦地扭曲！

messages.english: You feel your light-headedness will last longer.
messages.translation: 你感觉头晕还会持续更久。

messages.english: You feel your inability to drink will last longer.
messages.translation: 你感觉禁饮状态还会持续更久。

messages.english: You feel your silence will last longer.
messages.translation: 你感觉沉默还会持续更久。
一片不自然的寂静笼罩了你。

messages.english: You feel your vulnerability to fire will last longer.
messages.translation: 你感觉对火焰的脆弱状态还会持续更久。

messages.english: Cherry-coloured flames burn away your fire resistance!
messages.translation: 樱红色火焰烧去了你的火焰抗性！

messages.english: A part of your body evaporates into steam!
messages.translation: 你身体的一部分蒸发成了蒸汽！
你的自动炫光器发动反击！
致变能量流入你的体内。

messages.english: You feel a dangerous fate closing in on you...
messages.translation: 你感觉危险的命运正向你逼近……

messages.english: You feel very mighty all of a sudden.
Something gnaws heavily on your mind!
messages.translation: 某种力量猛烈啃噬着你的心灵！
某种力量啃噬着你的心灵！

messages.english: You feel your power leaking away.
Stolen life floods into an unseen void!
messages.translation: 被窃取的生命力涌入了看不见的虚空！

messages.english: You are pushed out of the doorway!
Vines fly forth from the trees!
messages.translation: 藤蔓从树木中飞射而出！

messages.english: Thorny briars emerge from the ground!
messages.translation: 带刺的荆棘从地上冒了出来！

messages.english: Zin's power protects your fellow warrior from evil magic!
messages.translation: 辛的力量保护你的战友免受邪恶魔法侵害！

messages.english: Send 'em back where they came from!
messages.translation: 把它们送回原来的地方去！

messages.english: An aura of fear fills the air!
messages.translation: 恐惧的气息弥漫在空气中！

messages.english: A freezing vortex appears out of thin air!
messages.translation: 一道冰冻涡流凭空出现！

messages.english: The long-dead rise up around you.
messages.translation: 早已死去的亡者在你周围起身。
你感知到一股邪恶的存在。

messages.english: An electric hum fills the air.
messages.translation: 空气中充满电流的嗡鸣。

messages.english: A wave of cold passes over you.
messages.translation: 一股寒流掠过你的身体。
你的法术记忆被打断了。
你停止为仆从灌注魔力。

messages.english: You begin to meditate on the wall.
You begin to dig a shaft.
You finish merging with the rock.
messages.translation: 你完成了与岩石的融合。

messages.english: ...yet there is something new on the other side. You quickly turn back.
messages.translation: ……但另一侧出现了新的东西。你迅速折返。

messages.english: ...and sense your way blocked. You quickly turn back.
messages.translation: ……并感到去路被阻。你迅速折返。
你完成了对仆从的魔力灌注。
你感知到附近有一只怪物。

messages.english: You have nothing you can fire or use right now.
messages.translation: 你现在没有可发射或使用的物品。

messages.english: You stand defiantly in death's doorway!
messages.translation: 你无畏地立于死亡之门前！

messages.english: You seem to hear sand running through an hourglass...
messages.translation: 你仿佛听见沙漏中流沙的声音……

messages.english: A film of ice covers your body!
messages.translation: 一层薄冰覆盖了你的身体！

messages.english: Your cloak of flame flares fiercely!
messages.translation: 你的烈焰斗篷猛烈燃烧！

messages.english: A sizzling cloak of flame settles atop your icy armour.
messages.translation: 一件嘶嘶作响的烈焰斗篷覆在你的寒冰护甲上。

messages.english: A protective cloak of flame settles atop you.
messages.translation: 一件保护你的烈焰斗篷覆在你身上。

messages.english: Your body is healed in an amazingly painful way.
messages.translation: 你的身体以极其痛苦的方式被治愈了。

messages.english: Your life is in your own hands once again.
messages.translation: 你的生命再次掌握在自己手中。

messages.english: You release your grip on the fallen and begin the cycle anew!
messages.translation: 你放开对亡者的掌控，开始新的循环！

messages.english: You call out to the remnants of the fallen!
messages.translation: 你呼唤亡者的残存之物！

messages.english: The fallen lash out in pain!
messages.translation: 亡者在痛苦中发动攻击！

messages.english: The ground around you becomes liquefied!
There is nobody nearby that the sprites are interested in.
messages.translation: 附近没有精灵们感兴趣的目标。
你准备好了一剂爆炸催化剂。

messages.english: A cloud of volatile blastmotes flares up around you! Run!
messages.translation: 一团不稳定爆炸微粒在你周围燃起！快跑！
神圣火焰突然包围了你！

messages.english: The air fills with toxic fumes!
There's no open space to fill with poison.
messages.translation: 没有可充满毒雾的空地。

messages.english: %s begins to grow on the wall!
%s is healed by the life force!

messages.translation: %s看起来变得更容易受到火焰伤害。

messages.english: %s is frozen into a solid block of ice!
%s is cursed with the promise of agony.
%s's movement is quickened by the wind!
%s shimmers and seems to become two!
%s channels a blast of cleansing flame!
%s binds the souls of nearby monsters.
%s curls into a ball and begins rolling!
You block the %s... and reflect it back!
messages.translation: 你挡住了%s……并将其反射回去！

messages.english: %s is now too close for your liking.
%s appear in pursuit of the Orb!
